create_rendezvous_handler: create a rendezvous handler by calling get_rendezvous_handler with RendezvousParameters
get_rendezvous_handler: get a rendezvous handler from the registry for a given RendezvousParameters instance
register_custom_handler: register a custom rendezvous handler with rendezvous_handler_registry using a backend name and factory function
register_default_handlers: register all default rendezvous handlers including etcd, etcd-v2, c10d, and static backends
create_etcd_handler: create an etcd-based rendezvous handler from RendezvousParameters using the etcd backend
